title: Double Comparatives (…တစ်လေ …တစ်လေ)

lessons.title: Double Comparatives: Cause and Effect
lessons.content: Double comparatives are used to express cause and effect. The structure is 'The + comparative + subject + verb, the + comparative + subject + verb'. As one thing changes, another thing changes in response.

details.explanation: Use 'the + comparative adjective/adverb' on both sides of the comma to show how two changes are linked.
details.example: The more meat he eats, the fatter he is.
details.burmese: သူ အသားအများစားသလောက် ဝလောက်တယ်။

details.explanation: Both clauses use 'the + comparative' to show how one change causes another.
details.example: The higher the sun is, the lower the shadow is.
details.burmese: နေမင်းလောက်မြင့်လေ အရိပ်က အောက်ကျလောက်တယ်။

details.explanation: As the first condition increases or decreases, the result follows.
details.example: The harder he worked, the richer he became.
details.burmese: သူ အလုပ်ကြိုးစားသလောက် ချမ်းသာလောက်တယ်။
